name: workbench
description: A complete process system for how work starts, gets designed, gets verified, and lands: user-sized audits, brainstorming that ends at your route pick (direct / plan / goal handoff), implementation discipline (TDD, systematic debugging, evidence-gated readiness), one adversarial review, and landing that files the PR and tends CI to green. Backed by five read-only review agents. Core process skills derived from obra/superpowers (MIT): no hooks, no dispatcher; skills fire on relevance.
